
  morphic lowers an API spec into Morphic IR.

  USAGE

    morphic [command] [--flags]

  COMMANDS

    compile <spec-file> [--flags]   Lower an API spec (OpenAPI 3.x) into Morphic IR JSON
    completion [command]            Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
    help [command]                  Show help for a command
    validate <spec-file> [--flags]  Check an API spec and report its diagnostics, writing no IR

  FLAGS

    -h --help                       Help for morphic
    -v --version                    Version for morphic
